subject: [PATCH RFC v4 07/12] mm: read remote strings under the per-VMA lock

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the __copy_remote_vm_str() function to read remote strings under a per-VMA lock instead of the mmap read lock, reducing contention and improving performance. The new implementation uses the existing remote_vm_walk() function with a copy_vm_str() action that copies each page and stops at the NUL character. If the string is too long, it falls back to the original mmap lock path. This change aims to improve the efficiency of reading strings from other processes' memory spaces.
